decision_skill.name: seasonal_difference_stability
decision_skill.description: Prefer forecasts anchored to the typical change observed between matching positions in repeated seasonal cycles when those changes are more stable than local adjacent movements.
decision_skill.applicability: When the series has a credible recurring cycle and matched seasonal differences are robust across recent history.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Compare the dispersion and validation error of matched-position seasonal changes against competing local or motif-based assumptions, then select the seasonal-difference candidate when it is consistently more stable and performs best on rolling pseudo-holdouts.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when seasonality is weak, the cycle length is uncertain, recent regime changes invalidate prior cycles, or rolling validation favors another candidate.
